title: AI Service Layer — Provider Abstraction, OpenRouter, Shader Prompts
description: Create the AI service layer with a provider abstraction interface (AIProvider), an OpenRouterProvider implementation using fetch + SSE streaming, and shader prompt engineering templates. The OpenRouterProvider should handle authentication via Electron IPC (API key from safeStorage), streaming responses, error handling with retries, and parse structured shader output (GLSL code + uniform definitions).
acceptance_criteria: AIProvider interface with generateShader(prompt, context) method
OpenRouterProvider implements AIProvider using fetch + SSE streaming
API key retrieved from Electron IPC (safeStorage)
SSE streaming with incremental response handling
Error handling with retry logic and exponential backoff
Shader prompt template produces structured output: GLSL code + uniform definitions
Response parser extracts ShaderComponent from AI output
Barrel index.ts exports provider and types
TypeScript strict mode passes with no errors
completion_summary: AI service layer with OpenRouterProvider, SSE streaming, retry/backoff, shader prompt engineering, response parser
